findings.title: Google google-extended hit a bot challenge
findings.detail: The google-extended user-agent got a challenge/verification response (403). Because google-extended is verified by reverse-dns, the real crawler may pass where this spoofed user-agent does not. Confirm the verified bot is allowlisted at your CDN.
findings.fix: Allowlist the crawler by its published IP ranges (verified bots) rather than relying on user-agent rules.

findings.title: Content is present without JavaScript
findings.detail: The raw HTML already contains meaningful text, so crawlers that do not execute JavaScript can read the page.

findings.title: robots.txt does not block the expected AI crawlers
findings.detail: None of the checked AI crawlers are shadowed by a wildcard disallow.

findings.title: No Content-Signal policy in robots.txt
findings.detail: Content-Signal in robots.txt is the canonical place to state training/search/ai-input preferences. It may still be set as an HTTP header, which fewer tools read.
findings.fix: Enable agentmarkup contentSignalHeaders so Content-Signal is written into robots.txt.

findings.title: llms.txt has errors
findings.detail: llms.txt must start with an H1 heading (# Site Name)

findings.title: llms.txt is not linked from the homepage
findings.detail: An llms.txt exists but the homepage has no <link rel="alternate" type="text/plain" href="/llms.txt">, so agents cannot discover it from the page.
findings.fix: agentmarkup injects this discovery link automatically.

findings.title: No JSON-LD structured data
findings.detail: The page has no JSON-LD. Structured data helps AI systems and search understand the page entity.
findings.fix: Add JSON-LD with agentmarkup schema presets (webSite, organization, article, …).

findings.title: Sitemap found
findings.detail: A sitemap is declared in robots.txt, which helps crawlers and AI systems discover all of your pages.

findings.title: Core page metadata present
findings.detail: The page has a title, a meta description, and a canonical link, which help AI systems and search attribute the page.

findings.title: Could not determine how missing paths are handled
findings.detail: The request for a path that should not exist did not complete, so it is unknown whether this site returns a real 404. A timeout or a block is not evidence of a soft-404.
